data.name: Barter to Currency
data.teaser: Overhauls all barter trades into proper currency offers. Fully configurable per trader, supports GP Coin, multipliers.
data.description:
BarterToCurrency

A complete overhaul of the deranged duct-tape economy. This mod rewrites all item-based barter trades into proper currency trades using each trader’s default money — roubles, dollars, euros, or Ref’s beloved GP Coins.

---

Features:

  • Converts barter trades into actual currency-based offers
  • Trader-specific settings:
    • Choose currency (roubles, dollars, euros, gpcoin)
    • Toggle conversion per trader
    • Optional per-trader price multipliers
  • Global price multiplier (fallback) and currency rate controls
  • GP Coin support with fixed ₽38,200 value
  • Dynamic price sourcing from Flea Market with fallback to handbook

---

Compatibility:

SPT-AKI 3.11.3 (build 35392)

Requires manual deletion of old mod folder (TheSaladGuy-BarterToRoubles)

Trader Quips:

  • Prapor – Keeps accepting gas analyzers and bolts like he’s building a nuclear barbecue in his basement. Switched to roubles, but his soul still barters in scrap metal and war trauma.
  • Therapist – Used to reward you with a case if you brought her enough dogtags to summon a ghost. She still takes roubles, but you’ll never escape the way she looks at your medbag like it owes her money.
  • Skier – Once offered a silencer for three lighters and your suppressed childhood memories. Now just wants cash, though the criminal energy remains.
  • Peacekeeper – Treats dollars like sacred relics and trades like he’s laundering gear for a CIA side op. He’ll take your money — just don’t ask where it goes.
  • Mechanic – Only spoke in processor fan noises and wanted every PC part except the one you had. Now accepts currency, but still stares at wires like they whisper secrets.
  • Jaeger – Offered a suppressor in exchange for toothpaste, a thermite grenade, and your left boot. Nothing has changed. We just price his madness in roubles now.
  • Ref – Exists solely in the Arena and negotiates using a GP Coin, three strokes of static, and your blood type. This mod tries to translate whatever the hell he’s saying.

versions.description:
**Changelog (2.0.0):**

- Complete rewrite from the original BarterToRoubles mod
- Rebuilt per-trader configuration system
- Currency logic now matches trader’s actual preference
- GP Coin barters now respect their trader, not just “ref”
- Config now uses vanilla currency conversion values
- Fixes:   
    
    - No more forcing roubles on every trade
    - Fixed config crashes from missing keys
    - Fixed ignored multipliers and skipped barters
